title: Add test infrastructure for orgos/agile tests
body:
Create tests/agile/ directory and add an empty __init__.py. This ensures the test discovery works for the wave module tests.

Files: tests/agile/__init__.py

Done: test directory is discoverable.

votes.justification: Adding a single empty __init__.py file is trivial from an implementation perspective, with no code logic, dependencies, or test complexity. Even accounting for directory creation and verifying pytest discovery, the effort is well under 30 minutes.
This is a trivial task — creating a single empty __init__.py file with no logic to test. Test discovery will just work; no risk from the test perspective.
